payload.core_mechanism_summary: BFS on 1D line: checks houses at distance 1, then 2, etc., from m until an affordable (price>0 and <=k) house is found.
payload.rationale: The algorithm expands outward from m in increasing distance, exploring both left and right systematically. This is exactly a BFS traversal on a line graph where each house is a node and adjacent houses are 10 meters apart.
